slides.communication_job: Make a bounded funding decision with a quantified hypothesis, clear scale gates and named accountability.
content_obligations: Annual research baseline 10,800 hours from 900 engagements × 12 research hours.
Potential annual capacity 1,944 hours from 60% adoption × 30% time reduction applied to the baseline.
Annual capacity equivalent $243k from 1,944 hours × $125 per hour. This is capacity value, not cash savings.
One practice, 15 consultants and 20 research-synthesis engagements in a 12-week pilot capped at $25k.

Scale-readiness table with cycle-time reduction at least 25%, at least 95% of sampled cited claims verified, zero critical data exceptions, and at least 70% weekly-active pilot users, meaning at least 11 of 15.
Concentrate on repeatable research work, embed review in the workflow and release funding against evidence.
Practice lead accountable. CFO sponsors investment. Every client release requires separate expert verification and engagement-lead approval.

slides.dominant_message: Keep expert ownership at every release
slides.communication_job: Show a controlled source-to-client flow and the responsibilities, evidence records and rejection feedback needed to operate it.
content_obligations: Directed chain Approved sources → Grounded draft → Expert review → Client-ready output.
Responsibility matrix with four stages and rows INPUT, OUTPUT, OWNER and RELEASE CONTROL.
Approved sources. Input corpus request. Output versioned source pack. Owner source steward. Control verify permissions and dates.
Grounded draft. Input source pack and task brief. Output cited draft and uncertainty flags. Owner engagement team. Control check citations and evidence gaps.
Expert review. Input draft and evidence trail. Output signed review or defect log. Owner expert reviewer. Control validate claims and quality.
Client-ready output. Input signed draft and resolved defects. Output authorized client deliverable. Owner engagement lead. Control confirm release approval.
Expert review returns rejected work to grounded draft with defect reasons. Grounded draft returns source corrections to approved sources via an exception register.
Shared controls. One exception register records each defect, owner and disposition. Platform team maintains access controls, audit logs and version history.
Pilot measurement. Compare 20 research tasks, one per engagement, against baseline time logs. Verify cited-claim samples and record expert review effort.
Release rule. No client use without expert and engagement-lead sign-off.

slides.dominant_message: Run the pilot through four evidence gates
slides.communication_job: Make workstream dependencies, decision dates, owners and deliverables operational through a time matrix.
content_obligations: Native workstream matrix with time columns weeks 1–2 Approve and baseline, weeks 3–4 Build and test, weeks 5–8 Pilot and learn, weeks 9–12 Prove and decide.
Data and access, owner source steward. Approved corpus and access register. Source refresh and named stewards. Weekly access and freshness checks. Audit closeout and release inventory.
Workflow and product, owner product lead. Task mapping and baseline time logs. Grounded draft and visible citations. 15-user pilot and defect fixes. Release candidate and runbook.
Quality and controls, owner expert reviewer. Risk boundaries and review criteria. Test pack and rejection reasons. 10 reviewed tasks and error triage. 20 completed tasks and gate evidence.
Adoption and value, owner practice lead. Sponsor, users and agreed tracking. Training, support and measurement plan. Weekly usage and feedback sessions. Benefit case and scale recommendation.

Evidence gates G1 week 2 corpus and access signed, G2 week 4 test pack approved, G3 week 8 ten tasks reviewed, G4 week 12 scale decision. Accountability moves from source steward to product lead to expert reviewer to practice lead and CFO.
Dependencies. Permissions precede retrieval tests. Approved test pack precedes the user pilot. Quality evidence precedes the benefit case.
Stop rule. No expansion while critical data exceptions remain open.

slides.dominant_message: Release the next investment against evidence
slides.communication_job: Expose the economic calculation, first-year ramp, scenario sensitivity and exact release conditions for the remaining investment.
content_obligations: Base-case annual capacity equation 900 engagements × 12 research hours × 60% adoption × 30% time reduction = 1,944 hours. At $125 per hour this is $243k annual capacity equivalent.
Native investment ledger. Implementation $85k includes the $25k pilot and conditional remaining $60k. Annual operations add $30k. Full first-year cost is $115k.
Native sensitivity table with a 50% first-year ramp. Downside 40% adoption and 20% time reduction give 864 hours, $108k annual capacity, $54k first-year capacity and −$61k against full cost.
Base 60% adoption and 30% time reduction give 1,944 hours, $243k annual capacity, $121.5k first-year capacity and +$6.5k against full cost.
Upside 75% adoption and 40% time reduction give 3,240 hours, $405k annual capacity, $202.5k first-year capacity and +$87.5k against full cost.
The model values released capacity. It does not claim revenue or cash savings. First-year value is 50% of annual potential.

GO when all four pilot gate thresholds hold and a practice lead owns rollout. HOLD for incomplete evidence or weak usage, within an agreed extension cap. STOP for a critical data-control failure and close the exception.
